THE ENGINE

3Draft

From a workbench
to the universe.

A compact 3D engine with a HEXAW-powered core, precise surface targeting and scenes stored as JSON. Materials lead the way — even interactive webpages and nested 3Draft scenes can become surfaces.

AI AT THE WORKBENCH

Give your agent
real tools.

From words to geometry.

3Draft gives compatible AI agents actual modelling operations through MCP: build meshes, move objects, inspect surfaces and render real scenes. No pretend screenshots — the result is editable geometry.

Explore the 3Draft MCP tools ↗
spi3der × ChatGPT

The workshop is here.

We built a native spi3der MCP App for ChatGPT. Ask an agent to model an object, then inspect it with spi3der’s original editor, panels and shortcuts directly in the conversation. Our eight-legged logo spider was created that way.
